# Calm Investments

> Calm Investments is an independent entrepreneurial investment firm based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands (founded 2021). It focuses on acquiring and investing in small and midsized Dutch companies with a leading role in their niche market, using its own capital and without external funds.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2021, Rotterdam
- Office: Elevatorhuis, Parklaan 8, 3016 BB Rotterdam, the Netherlands
- Contact: j.vanderhelm@calminvestments.com, +316-1233 8883
- Founders: Olav van Caldenborgh (previously CEO of Caldic; acquired and integrated 20+ companies) and Jonathan van der Helm (previously strategy consultant at Roland Berger; MSc Offshore Engineering, TU Delft)
- Capital: 100% own capital, no external funds
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/80161694/

## Focus

- Geography: the Netherlands
- Sectors: niche manufacturing, value-added distribution, food, machine building, healthcare and pharma
- Investment criteria: EBITDA EUR 0.5m to 5m, niche market leaders with mission-critical offerings, high value-to-cost proposition, consistent earnings history, identifiable growth potential, experienced management team, majority stake, no fixed exit horizon

## Approach

Long-term entrepreneurial partnership with management, based on transparency, integrity and mutual trust. No exit-driven strategy. Support includes data analytics, growth strategy development, evaluating and executing acquisitions, financial support and operational collaboration. Calm Investments invests its own capital, which means direct communication, strong ownership and fast decision-making.

## Portfolio

- Mineraux (https://www.mineraux.nl/): white pigment manufacturer, the world's only safe and equally white replacement for titanium dioxide (E171), for food contact, plastics, inks and toys
- Veldt Cookies (https://www.veldtcookiescrackers.nl/): producer of premium cookies and biscuits in Wageningen since 1970, supplying retail, wholesale, bakery chains and foodservice
- Veldt Crackers (https://www.onoats.nl/): producer of artisan oat crackers and granola under the OnOats brand, free from wheat, refined sugars and lactose
